name: What is involved in custom window seat construction?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in custom window seat construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom window seat construction involves designing, building, and installing a built-in seating area within a window recess. This process typically includes framing the structure, adding storage solutions like drawers or lift-top benches, and finishing with trim and paint to match your home's aesthetic. As Hometelligent Inc., we begin with a detailed consultation to understand your vision and measure the space, ensuring the final product integrates seamlessly with your existing architecture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom window seat construction involves designing and building a built-in seating area, often with storage, to fit a window recess.
